annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Digitalisation of justice in the European Union. A toolbox of opportunities' (COM(2020) 710 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on 'Communication from the Commission ... Digitalisation of justice in the European Union. A toolbox of opportunities' (COM(2020) 710 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 286/88
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion welcoming the Commission's 2020 Communication on digitalisation of justice in the EU. It urges harmonised rules, funding, a directive on remote judicial proceedings, wider cross-border enforcement and data access, while safeguarding privacy. It does not address AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a Commission directive on judicial proceedings held at distance via any video-call medium protecting privacy
Calls for more homogeneous rules across Member States, e.g. for e-CODEX use
Urges digital enforcement of judgments across Member States
Calls for EU funding and training, excluding states breaching rule of law
Wants electronic transmission as default and safeguards for data protection
